tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// dpal sgyu ma bde ba chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba/ dpal sgyu ma chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul gyis// srid pa'i sgyu ma rnam sbyong ba// sgyu ma chen mor phyag 'tshal nas// sgyu ma rnam par rol pa bshad// myong snang bzhin du ma grub phyir// 'di kun sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul te// de nyid las ni byung ba'i phyir// grol ba'ang ci phyir sgyu ma min// de phyir bud med sgyu ma yi// rnam par rol pas rol pa yis// bde chen rol pas rol 'gyur ba'i// thabs 'di bla na med pa yin// dbang dang dam tshig thob pa yis// dngos grub don du rnal 'byor bsgom// mnyam par gzhag dang yan lag gi /rnal 'byor gnyis kyis bsdus pa yin// de la mnyam par gzhag pa la gnyis las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ rang he ru kar skad cig gis dmigs pa'i snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi yi ge sngon po las 'od byung bas rang dang gzhan gyi sgrib pa sbyangs nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor bla mas dbur brgyan pa spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥdang*/ na maḥshrī he ru ka ma hā mā yā maṇ+ḍal bh+yaḥs bla ma dang dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal nas/ snying ga nas sprul pa'i me tog la sogs pa phyi dang*/ nang bdud rtsis mchod la/ bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba// ma lus sangs rgyas spyan sngar ni// bdag gis so sor bshags par bgyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi// tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// sgyu 'phrul gtso bo yab yum dang*// mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa dang*// chos mchog la yang skyabs su mchi// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis// byang chub sems mchog bskyed pa ltar// de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams kyis// sangs rgyas myur du 'grub 'gyur te// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// bla med gnas su sgrol bar shog

/ces lan gsum brjod nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba mtha' dag dang phrad par 'dod pa'i byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag las bsgral bar 'dod pa'i snying rje dang*/ bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa'i dga' ba dang*/ chags sdang med cing mnyam pa nyid kyi btang snyoms te tshad med pa bzhi bsgom mo// bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas he ru ka āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod nas/ he ni chos thams cad rgyu dang bral zhing 'phel ba dang 'grib pa med la/ yongs su rtog pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba'o// ru ni chos thams cad sgra brnyan dang 'dra zhing dga' ba dang ldan la skye 'gag dang bral ba'o// ka ni chos thams cad gnas pa dang bral zhing bde ba dang ldan la ma skyes pa'i de kho na nyid de/ yi ge gsum gyi don dang ldan pa nyid do// zhes dran par byas la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgoms pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas stong pa nyid kyi ngang las sngon gyi smon lam gyi rnam 'phrul las byung ba'i paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las phyogs kun du 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ rwa ba dang*/ drwa ba dang*/ gur dang*/ bla re dang*/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas yongs su bskor ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom mo// de'i nang du e las byung ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi nang du yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ bam̐ las chu/ lam̐ las sa/ bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo rnams 'dres pa las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi/ phyi rol nas rim pa bzhin/ sngon po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang gu/ dkar po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang zhing mda' yab dang pu shus yongs su bskor ba/

gzhi'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis bskor ba/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris nas mdzes par phub pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje nor bu rin po che'i tog gis mtshan pa/ sgo'i steng du ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi pa chos kyi 'khor lo dang gdugs dang ri dwags dang bcas pa/ gzhan yang gos dang*/ 'phan dang*/ me long dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ rnga yab la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas spras shing kun du sgrib pa med pa'i phyi rol gyi khor yug tu shar nas rim pa bzhin du/ drag tu gtum pa/ 'jigs par byed pa/ 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ tshang tshing 'khrigs pa dang*/ me nas rim pa bzhin/ dbang phyug nags tshal/ mun pa mi bzad pa/ ki li ki li'i sgra sgrogs pa/ ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod brgyad du de nyid kyi rim pas brgya byin/ gshin rje/ chu lha/ gnod sbyin/ me lha/ srin po/ rlung lha/ dbang ldan te phyogs skyong ba brgyad/ shing chen po brgyad la gnas pa'i zhing skyong chen po brgyad/ mchod rten chen po brgyad/ chu chen po brgyad/ me chen po brgyad/ sprin chen po brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ ro dang*/ ro langs la sogs pas gang bar bsam/ gzhal yas khang pa'i dbus su rdo rje'i phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar ro dang bcas pa'i nyi ma'i gdan dang*/ phyogs bzhir nyi ma 'ba' zhig gi gdan dang*/ mtshams bzhir bum pa la gnas pa'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi dang*/ lha snam gyi khor yug tu bcud sna tshogs kyis gang zhing 'bras bu dang ldan pa'i shing gis kha brgyan pa'i bum pa brgyad gnas par bsgom mo// de nas brten pa lha bskyed pa'i phyir gdan dbus ma'i steng du rang gi sems he ru ka yab yum du skad cig gis lhag par mos nas snyoms par zhugs pas rjes su chags pas nye bar bskul bas khams gnyis bha gar son pa spros pas gdan bzhi'i steng du thig le'i gzugs bzhir blta'o// mthar rjes su chags pa'i mes yab yum gnyis kyang 'od du zhu nas bde ba chen po'i ngo bo thig le gcig tu gyur par bsgom mo// de nas skad cig gis phyogs bzhi'i thig le rnams rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhir gyur nas/

kye ho gnyen mchog rdo rje'i 'od kyis pad+ma sad mdzad pa// a la la ho// bde ba chen po'i dgyes pa'i gar mdzod cig /nyi ma'i 'od kyis pad+mo kha 'byed ltar// a la la ho// bde ba chen po'i gar gyis rab tu dgyes par mdzod// ces mgrin gcig tu glus bskul nas/ lha mo rnams skar mda'i tshul gyis dbus kyi thig le la 'dres shing gcig tu gyur pa'i thig le dum bu gsum du gyur te/ 'og gi thig le ā li las zla ba dang*/ steng gi kā li las nyi ma dang*/ bar gyi hūm̐ las rdo rje kha ṭ+wā?ṃ ga hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams gcig tu 'dres pa las byung ba'i dpal he ru ka ni sku mdog sngon po zhal bzhi pa phyag bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo ba/ g.yas ser ba/ rgyab dmar ba/ g.yon ljang ba/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'phyar ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis mda' dang gzhu 'dzin cing 'di nyid kyis mi'i g.yang gzhi gos su gyon pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan zhing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba g.yas brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'o// de'i pang na gnas pa'i yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'ang kha dog dang phyag mtshan dang nyams yab dang mtshungs pa nyid de/ 'on kyang phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can no// gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ lte bar swā ser po/ brla gnyis la hā ljang gu bkod nas/ yum gyi bha ga pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la as mtshan pa dang*/ yab kyi gsang gnas rdo rje sngon po rtse mo lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan par byin gyis brlabs nas/

lha rnams dbyung ba'i phyir snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul nas nye bar spyan drangs pa zhal du zhugs/ snying gar rab tu bzhu/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa thig le bzhir gyur pa las byung ba'i rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi rim pa bzhin nam mkha'i khams khyab par spros/ rang rang dang rjes su 'brel ba'i sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus nas gcig tu gyur pa las phyogs bzhir 'khod par bsams te/ de'ang shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo zhal g.yas ser/ rgyab dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na rdo rje dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga g.yon pa gnyis na dril bu dang*/ ka pā la 'dzin pa/ lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ zhal g.yas sngo/ rgyab dmar/ g.yon ljang ba/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ rtse gsum/ g.yon pa gnyis na ba dan rtse gsum pa dang*/ rtse spyang 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhal g.yas ser/ rgyab sngo/ g.yon ljang ba/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na pad+ma dang mda'/ g.yon pa gnyis na ka pā la dang*/ gzhu 'dzin pa/ byang du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu/ g.yas ser/ rgyab dmar/ g.yon sngo ba/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na ral gri dang*/ ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon pa gnyis na ka pā la dang*/ zhags pa 'dzin pa ste/ thams cad kyang zhal bzhi phyag bzhi ma/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i rgyan dang cha lugs can no// de nas snga ma ltar de dag thams cad kyi gnas lnga byin gyis brlab bo// mig tu oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ām̐ḥdamar po/ rna bar a ser po/ snar ṣe dkar po/ dpral bar tsi ser po/ snying gar hūm̐ dmar po dmigs pa rnams/ skye mched rnam par dag pa rdo rje ma drug tu bltas la/ rang gi snying gi nang gi hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sgyu ma chen po'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/

phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pas mnyes par byas te/ rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i rtsa ba'i phyag gis lcags kyu/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin pa rnams snying ga nas rim gyis spros pas ye shes pa rnams dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du byas pas rang dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam zhing*/ so so'i phyag rgya dang ldan pas/ oṃ e h+ye hi shrī he ru ka ma hā mā yā maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba ḍā ki nī/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pā sha hrī/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ā be sha aḥ zhes brjod do// phyi ma la ni e he hi mi sbyor ro// de nas yang hūm̐ gi 'od kyi snang bas mkha' 'gro ma lnga dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i rigs lnga rang rang gi rigs dang rjes su 'brel pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i dbang gi lha spyan drangs la/ snga ma bzhin mchod cing bstod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lngas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba yang dag sbyin// badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing*/ ye shes lnga'i ngo bo bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur/ rig mas glu dang*/ sems dpas bkra shis dang*/ khro bos bar chad sel ba dang*/ lha mos mchod pa'i las mdzad de/ chu'i rgyun des lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma bzhi dag dbang bzhi thob/ lam bzhi bsgom zhing*/ sku bzhi thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ dbang rtags su he ru ka la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma lnga la rim pa bzhin rtag pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/

pad+ma dang*/ las kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas mdun du mngon par 'du byas pa'i bdud rtsi gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa myangs pas lha thams cad bdud rtsis yongs su gang zhing bde ba dang ting nge 'dzin gyi ro dam pa myang bar bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas lha mo rnams dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyi bdag nyid he ru ka la mgrin gcig tu bstod par bsam zhing*/ mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs pa'i gzugs// sngags kyi me tog phreng bas brgyan// sha chen rab tu gsol mdzad pa// he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes brjod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stu ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes kyang brjod do// de nas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor snang la rang bzhin med pa la sems gtad de/ ji srid gnas kyi bar du yid mnyam par gzhag go /bskyed pa'i rim pa dbyibs kyi bdag nyid do// //de nas dmigs pa thams cad nye bar zhi zhing thabs shes rab zung du 'jug par bya ba'i phyir/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ snying ga nas spros pa'i 'od kyis snod bcud dang rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams rang la bsdus shing yum yang bsdus nas/ yab 'ba' zhig tu gnas pa'i snying pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i rnam par gnas pa'i dbus su thig le'i ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sen mo bzlum pa tsam dang*/ de'i steng du rak+ta'i ngo bo nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor tshad de tsam gnyis kyi bar du rlung dang khams dang sems 'dres pa'i thig le yungs 'bru tsam zhig bsams nas de la sems cung zhig gtad do// de nas thig le las sgra sing pa cig byung bas rkyen byas nas steng gi zla ba la bu ga shin tu phra ba cig dod de/ thig le las 'od kyi srad bu rta rnga brgyar gshags pa'i tshad ltar phra ba cig la nyi zer ltar phra ba'i ā li kā li phreng ba'i tshul du brgyus pa gcig dbugs phyir rgyu ba dang mtshungs par 'thon/

nyi zla kha sbyor la lan phyed dang bdun du kris/ yid kyis oṃ zhes brjod/ dbugs nang du zhugs pa'i tshe bcings pa slar grol yid kyis āḥzhes brjod/ rlung gnas pa'i bu ga nas zhugs te thig le la thim par bsam zhing yid kyis hūm̐ zhes brjod do// 'di'i rim pas rtag tu bsgoms pas rtags dang yon tan 'byung bar 'gyur te/ sngags kyi bdag nyid kyi rim pa'o// //de'i rjes su nyi zla thig le dang bcas pa snga ma ltar dmigs nas rlung nang du drangs pas yi ge dang bcas pa'i srad bu 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung dang lhan cig thig le la thim ste zla ba'i bu ga'ang subs nas nyi zla ga'u 'grigs pa ltar kha sbyar bar bsam zhing steng 'og gi rlung yang kha sbyor du bya'o// rlung phyir gtong ba'i tshe yi ge dang bcas pa'i srad bu byung zhing phyed dang bdun du dkris par bsam mo// 'di'i rim pas rtag tu bsgoms nas snga ma pas lhag pa'i rtags dang yon tan 'byung bar 'gyur te/ dmigs pa dang bcas pa'i chos kyi bdag nyid kyi rim pa gnyis pa'o// //de'i rjes su rang nyid he ru ka'i sku stod nyi ma sku smad zla ba nyi zla'ang thig le la thim nas thig le nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar mi dmigs par 'gyur ba'i ngang la yid mnyam par gzhag go /tshul 'di rtag tu bsgoms pa las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes skye bar 'gyur te/ dmigs pa med pa'i chos kyi bdag nyid kyi rim pa gsum pa'o// //rgya cher de kho na nyid kyi man ngag las shes par bya'o// rdzogs pa'i rim pa ste mnyam par gzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro// nyal ba dang ni ldang ba dang*// mchod gtor zas kyi bya ba dang*// bzlas pa dang ni spyod lam ste// yan lag drug gis yan lag bsdus// de la thog mar nyal ba'i tshe/ snying ga'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab ste/ tshur 'dus pas snod bcud dang 'khor 'das rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad gtso bo yab yum la bsdus nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i rjes su chags pa'i mes gtso bo yab yum yang 'od du zhu nas nam mkha'i dbyings su g.yo ba med pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le gcig tu gyur par bsams la mi rtog pa'i ngang la nyal bar bya'o// nyal ba'o// ldang ba'i tshe sngon gyi 'phen pa'i dbang gis thig le de las thig le bzhi 'phros pa lha mo bzhir gyur pas kye ho la sogs pa'i glus bskul te slar 'dres nas gtso bo yab yum gyi skur bzhengs te thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyi snang bas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa snod bcud dang bcas par dmigs la hūm̐ gi sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo// ldang ba'o// de nas snga dro'i thun mnyam gzhag gong du bshad pa ltar bsgoms nas tshogs 'dums shing bar chad thams cad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir mchod pa dang gtor ma bya ba'i rim pa ni chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga/

nang gi mchod pa/ gtor ma gnyis/ rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa mngon du byas nas bdag bskyed gtso bo 'ba' zhig tu bsdus la/ rdzas rnams bsangs shing sbyangs te/ yi ge gsum las grub pa'i lha rdzas su byin gyis brlab bo// de nas bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal la ba byung dri bzang dang bcas pas khye ma med par byug cing*/ der rten gyi dkyil 'khor skad cig gis dmigs la/ lha'i gnas rnams su dri'i thig le me tog re dang bcas pa rnams gdan du mos nas so so'i sngags brjod cing me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa rnams skad cig gis lha rnams su gsal bar dmigs la/ mtshams bzhir yang tshom bu cung zad re bkod pa rnams bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa rnams su blta'o// de nas rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i bar bdag bskyed dang mtshungs par byas la gtso bo'i rigs bdag rtsa ba'i bla mar mos shing steng gi nam mkha' la brgyud pa'i bla ma phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang*/ khor yug tu byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang*/ chos skyong ba dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba bzhugs par bsam mo// de nas phyag rgya dang bcas pas gang gi mchod rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin dngos su dbul zhing*/ sems kyis re re'ang nam mkha'i khams gang bas kyang mchod par mos la ngag tu/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī he ru ka ma hā mā yā maṇ+ḍal tsakra sarba ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod yon dbul lo// de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pā d+yaṃ gis zhal bsil/ me tog dang puṣ+paṃ/ bdug spos dang dhū paṃ/ mar me dang dī paṃ/ dri mchog dang gan+dhaṃ/

zhal zas dang nai be d+ye/ sil snyan dang shap+ta/ zhes pa rnams dang spel bas mchod rdzas de dag gis mchod par bya'o// de nas nang mchod gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis gtor bas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang*/ yi dam gyi lha rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phul nas/ myang zhing gnas gsum du gtugs pas rang gi lus kyi lha'ang mchod la/ chos skyong ba dang*/ 'jig rten pa thams cad la'ang sbyin no// de nas phyag 'tshal ba'am/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yul gyi yon tan rjes su dran zhing*/ gang gi drin gyis la sogs pa bla ma'i bstod pa dang*/ mche ba gtsigs pa la sogs pa he ru ka dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los sgyur// ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid// 'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo// ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// kun du rtogs pa'i 'ching gcod cing*// 'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug pa// de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas mkha' 'gro ma rnams la bstod cing*/ gzhan yang ci shes pas bstod par bya'o// de nas nyes ltung dag par bya ba'i phyir/ bshags pa gtso bor gyur pa'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sdom pa gzung ba dang*/ smon lam rgya chen po rnams gdab par bya'o// mchod pa'o// de nas gtor ma gnyis mngon par 'du byas pa'i thog ma a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me'i steng du āḥlas thod pa'i nang du dbus nas rim pa bzhin du/ hūm̐/ oṃ/ trām̐/ hrīḥ āḥlas/ mi/ glang*/ khyi/ rta/ glang po che'i sha lnga dang*/ shar lho nas rim pa bzhin/ lam̐/ mam̐/ pam̐/ tām̐ las/ dri chen/ dri chu/ byang chub kyi sems/ rak+ta rnams bskyed nas de rnams kyi steng du/ oṃ dkar po mgo thur du blta ba/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa rnams bskyed nas/

hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos shing me sbar bas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams bzhu zhing*/ de'i rlangs pas oṃ dang rdo rje la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun zags shing 'od kyi tshul du phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi nye bar bkug pa rdo rje la thim pas zla ba dang*/ oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung zhing 'dres pa las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por dmigs la yi ge gsum yang brjod cing byin gyis brlab bo// de nas steng gi nam mkhar rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor skad cig gis lhag par mos la/ gong gi yi ge gsum dang drug gis gnas rnams byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying ga'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā mā yā badz+ra/ a ga dha ya a ga dha ya/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ ban+dha ya ban+dha ya/ dho sha ya dho sha ya/ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki nī hṛ da yaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod nas bstim mo// de nas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la bstabs pas lha rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥpra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ma hā pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bud+dhā ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ trāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ hrīḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba ḍā ka nī pra tīts+tsha i maṃ ba liṃ ho hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci rigs pa brjod pas phul nas/ phyi nang yid las byung bas mchod de/ mi bskyod pa ni ye shes che// rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po// rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum// rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod// rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che// rdo rje zhi ba dag chen po// rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog

/sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab// rdo rje nam mkha' dri ma med// dngos nyid dag pas gos pa med// rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje mi 'chi 'dod chags che// mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin// 'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes// pad+ma'i mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje dag pa gdon mi za// bsam pa thams cad yongs rdzogs pa// sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod nas 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo// 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma ni mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis yul phyogs de na gnas pa'i zhing skyong bas gtso byas pa'i 'jig rten pa rnams bkug par bsam zhing*/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas bkug nas pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul la/ me tog la sogs pas mchod de/ sa ma ya staṃ gyis dam tshig la gnas par bsgoms nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ k+ṣe tra pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ma ma sa pa ri wā ra s+ya sarba satwā ñtsa sarba pā paṃ byā dhi bigh+nān shān+tiṃ ku ru dhā na pu ṇ+ya ā yur+puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru sarba ya ku ru ku ru/ zhes lan gsum brjod de phul nas phrin las bcol la chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas gnyis ka'i mthar bkra shis dang smon lam brjod la bzod par gsol nas gshegs su gsol zhing dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor rang la bsdus nas gnas gsum bsrung ngo*// bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas dam tshig pa rang la bsdus la/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// mchod pa dang gtor ma'i rim pa'o// zas kyi bya ba ni kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas rang he ru kar dmigs pa'i lte bar gtum mo'i me sbar ba'i me lce'i khrod du snying gar lha'i dkyil 'khor bla mas dbur brgyan pa la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba dang*/

lto bar chos skyong srung ma dur khrod kyi bdag po phyogs bdag dang zhing skyong la 'jig rten pa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba dmigs nas/ lag pa gnyis dgang blugs kha hom khung lce'i rtsa bar rdo rje rtse lnga pa sbu gu dang bcas pa bsams la nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul gyis zos pas rdo rje'i sbu gu nas bdud rtsi'i char babs pas 'khor 'das kyi lha thams cad mnyes shing tshim par bsam mo// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu h+ye/ bak+ṣ+ya bak+ṣ+ya haṃ zhes pa ni bdud rtsi myang ba'i sngags so// lhag ma ni lhag ma la dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la sbyin pa ni zas kyi bya ba'o// de nas bskyed rim gyi rjes sam gang yang rung bar bzlas pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ lha rnams kyi thugs kar sa bon rnams dmigs nas gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas zhal nas 'thon/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ bha ga nas 'thon/ yab kyi gsang ba'i gnas nas zhugs shing 'khor bas rang dang gzhan gyi don gnyis byas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ zhes pa ni gtso bo'i sngags so// oṃ bud+dha ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ gtso mo'i'o// 'khor gyi lha mo rnams la ni rang rang gi thugs kar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yon skor du 'khor bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī āḥhrīḥhūm̐/ lha mo rnams kyi'o// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ thun mong gi sngags so// 'bum phrag brgyad bzlas pas ni dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba la 'jug par dbang zhing mchog sgrub pa la ni tshad med do// bzlas pa'o// spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar dmigs nas dag par dran par bya ste/ gzhal yas khang pa ni lam gyi tshogs rnam par dag pa/ dur khrod ni 'khor ba dang lus rnam par dag pa/

srung ba'i 'khor lo ni mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ni sa dang gzugs dang gti mug dag pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ni chu dang tshor ba dang ser sna dag pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro ni me dang 'du shes dang 'dod chags dag pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ni rlung dang 'du byed dang phrag dog dag pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ nam mkha' dang rnam par shes pa dang zhe sdang dag pa ni sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma/ de dag thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni dpal he ru ka'o zhes dag pa dran par byas nas lha mo rnams zhal bzhi bsdus shing yum yang yab la bsdus nas/ yab kyi dbang po lnga lha mo lngar dmigs la/ rang gi lus dang snang ba thams cad he ru ka brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags/ sems kyi rnam par rtog pa thams cad ye shes kyi cho 'phrul du dmigs nas yul rnams kyis skye mched kyi lha la mchod par bsam zhing*/ sdang zhen med par longs spyad do// spyod lam mo// //de ltar mnyam gzhag dang yan lag gi rnal 'byor gnyis la rtag tu legs par gnas pa ni dngos grub ma lus pa'i mthar son pa rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang yang ring por mi thogs par 'gyur ro// 'di yi brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// ku ku ri pa mtsho skyes ḍoṃ bi pa// ti lo nā ro zhi ba bzang por bcas// chos kyi blo gros chos kyi rdo rje dang*// zhe sdang rdo rje la sogs yab sras dang*// dbang phyug grags dang mkhyen rab dpal las brgyud// ku ku ri pa 'dul ba sbyin dang shān+ti pa// dam tshig rdo rje sogs kyis sbyar ba'i sgrub thabs dang*// 'brel pa'i tshogs kyang mthong zhing thos la man ngag gis// nges par byas pas chos tshul 'di la bdag blo dge /de ming blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal// de la ye shes 'byung gnas dpal// tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang bcas pas// gsol ba btab nas 'di sbyar ro// byed pa sgyu ma las byung ba'i// dge ba sgyu ma gang bsags pas// 'khor ba'i sgyu ma ma lus pa// ye shes sgyu mar rol gyur cig

/dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba/ dge slong sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes bya bas shing mo glang gi lo ston zla ra ba la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba rdzogs so/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
